title: NightmareDiscourseBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Fictional Direct Discourse Identification Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.27059v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we introduce a new benchmark dataset, NightmareDiscourseBench, for testing NLP pipelines that identify forms of direct discourse in English-language fiction. We first review existing publicly available benchmarks (providing summary statistics and reviewing available metadata) for this task, identifying theoretical inconsistency and exclusive focus on speech as primary issues in this domain. We then overview our narrative theory-based framework for classifying and evaluating different forms of direct discourse, and finally describe NightmareDiscourseBench, a new benchmark test set of 12 text samples accompanied by metadata pertinent to the task of direct discourse identification.

translated_title: NightmareDiscourseBench：用于小说直接话语识别流水线的基准数据集
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一个新的基准数据集NightmareDiscourseBench，用于测试识别英语小说中直接话语形式的NLP流水线。我们首先回顾了该任务现有的公开可用基准数据集（提供汇总统计信息并审查可用的元数据），指出了理论上的不一致性以及仅关注言语是该领域的主要问题。随后，我们概述了基于叙事理论的框架，用于分类和评估不同形式的直接话语，最后描述了NightmareDiscourseBench，这是一个包含12个文本样本的新基准测试集，并附有与直接话语识别任务相关的元数据。
tldr: 本文提出了一个新基准数据集NightmareDiscourseBench，基于叙事理论构建直接话语分类评估框架，弥补了现有基准数据理论不一致和仅关注言语形式的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NightmareDiscourseBench, a new benchmark dataset for testing NLP pipelines that identify direct discourse in English fiction, featuring a narrative theory-based classification framework that addresses the theoretical inconsistencies and speech-only focus of existing benchmarks.
